# 2 Baruch Chapter 71 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "And those bright waters which come last: these are the healing of those who are left behind, and the fountain of those who will remain in the world to come."

**2** "These are the eighth bright waters which you saw."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
